critical_code_review_comments: Chinese-wall check at lines 953-978 is correctly layered: (1) intersects owner.copropriete_ids with syndic's ACP ids, (2) falls back to checking lots collection for owner_id/owner_ids under syndic ACPs, (3) final fallback compares owner.syndic_id == request.state.syndic_id. Robust for both legacy and new-style ownership records.

Target-ACP guard (line 948) runs BEFORE the fetch/same-syndic check, so if requester lacks access to the target ACP the endpoint short-circuits without leaking owner existence — good defense-in-depth.
